title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: The world is changing faster than ever before.
sentences.zh: 世界比以往任何时候变化得都快。

sentences.en: A new railway links our town to the capital.
sentences.zh: 一条新铁路把我们的小镇与首都连了起来。

sentences.en: The government supports farmers to plant bushes and trees.
sentences.zh: 政府支持农民种植灌木和树木。

sentences.en: The wind lifts the sandy soil during a sandstorm.
sentences.zh: 沙尘暴来时，风会卷起沙质土壤。

sentences.en: E-payment is very convenient and saves a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 电子支付非常方便，能节省很多时间。

sentences.en: Our farm uses a greenhouse to grow vegetables all year.
sentences.zh: 我们的农场用温室全年种蔬菜。

sentences.en: The tunnel makes the trip much shorter.
Many villagers have moved into new housing.
sentences.zh: 许多村民搬进了新住房。

sentences.en: With high-tech tools, farmers can work with ease.
sentences.zh: 借助高科技工具，农民干活很轻松。
